column1: # What to verify when a change touches these paths, one row per incident it
# would have caught. Read by tools/verify-changed.sh (bash doctor.sh --changed)
# from the merge base, so a branch can add rows but not drop or narrow its own.
#   id        unique; tests/verify-changed.test.sh replays an incident commit for each
#   paths     bash patterns, space-separated; a * crosses /
#   diff      an ERE a changed line or hunk header of those paths must match, or -
#   check     tests/*.test.sh suites that --run runs, or an instruction to do by hand
#   incident  the PR, issue or commit it comes from
